work_item: BB-MATH-DATA current route replay for bounded B03 mathematics and B06 multi-step calculation

test_execution.route_method: The normal_route integration tests start the actual minidora-rust executable in child processes with fresh temporary stores; no result or action is injected. Assertions inspect returned and stored route values.

unproductive_filter_probe.reason: The exact filter did not match the five suffixed test names; the corrected non-exact filter above ran those five tests.

B03.scope: Selected normal CLI cases, not the complete algebra/statistics/probability contract.
observed: Japanese decimal statistics input [0.1,0.2,0.3] retains the original decimal lexemes and reports exact sum 3/5, mean/median 1/5, extrema 1/10 and 3/10, population variance 1/150 and sample variance 1/100.
Japanese and English finite-weight normalization reports exact normalized fractions and sum 1; zero-total weights produce a typed SUSPEND.
Japanese and English finite expectation/variance reports include normalized probabilities and per-outcome contribution arrays; examples report expectation 2/1 and variance 3.
Japanese and English finite-event probability reports include membership and exact per-outcome mass; examples report 9/10 and 1/4.
Japanese and English bounded polynomial evaluation reports each exact term contribution; examples report 3 and 17.

Normal CLI linear/quadratic equation cases report exact rational solutions, identity and contradiction classes, and suspend on an unsupported degree; a supplied 2x2 linear system retains its original matrix and exact solution [2,1].

B06.scope: Bounded declared calculation sequences; not general natural-language multi-step planning.
observed: The final step consumes the exact prior value 5 and yields 10; the sequence report, graph and result retain step identities and dependencies.
A fresh CLI process follow-up `詳しく説明して` references the saved result and exact calculation; explicit version 2 computes 14 while preserving the original result.
Malformed references, unsupported quantity contexts, action/deadline/evidence limits and arithmetic errors preserve only actual step progress and do not create a final report or effect receipt.

With an exact local write grant, emitted file bytes match rendered text and one CONFIRMED receipt records the target/hash/length; exact retry leaves bytes and modification time unchanged and retains one action receipt.
